blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Thursday called on the public to bear with temporary inconveniences brought about by the country’s hosting of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, saying its benefits for the Philippines would outweigh them. In his BBM Vlog 285: Asean 2026, Marcos said the gathering would yield policies that would, in turn, create jobs for Filipinos. He said, “Isang napakalaking karangalan ang mag-host ng Asean Summit kaya’t ito ay magandang pagkakataon para sa atin na ipakita, hindi lang sa Southeast Asia, kung hindi sa buong mundo, kung gaano kaganda ang ating bansa, kung gaano kahusay […]...
